strategy: Defer first POST until all current historical entries expire; max one conditional operator load; reserve a minute for load/preflight. Then schedule genuine benchmark turns every210s (3m30), dynamically recheck rolling ledger AND real AgentLimits before each. No reset/identity switch. No fake keepalive requests.
keepAlive: Prior approved procedure5m; 210s spacing gives nominal90s slack, not residency guarantee. Production request unchanged and refreshes its own normal keepalive. Any eviction/slow operator/interruption => STOP remaining NOT RUN; no second warm-up even if cap inference remains.
batchAlternative: Burst available slots then long wait is unsafe under5m keepalive and single-load cap. Only propose separate approval for additional preparation/contract change if owner prefers burst batches; not authorized here.
noQuotaApproval: This task grants zero inference or preload; previous task approvals not reused. Proposed scope needs new explicit owner approval.
